title: Search a STAC API through the contract Dataset
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that searches the STAC API rooted at <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL>/stac/v1. Use the contract API from @honua/sdk-js: HonuaClient with { baseUrl: <base URL>/stac/v1 }, createDataset from @honua/sdk-js/contract with one source { id: "sentinel", protocol: "stac", locator: { url: <base URL>/stac/v1, collectionId: "sentinel-2-l2a", layout: "stac-api" }, capabilities: PROTOCOL_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES.stac } and skipCompatibilityCheck: true. Query with { pagination: { limit: 2 } }. Each returned feature has attributes (the STAC item properties) and geometry. Print exactly one line to stdout: {"count": <result.features.length>, "hasGeometry": <true when every returned feature has a non-null geometry>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: STAC item search through the protocol-neutral Source.
